ns2:course.label: Economics of Stock Market Fundamentals
ns2:course.description: A firm's long-run value ultimately depends on its business fundamentals. This course covers micro- and macro-economic drivers of such fundamentals, such as consumer demand, market competitiveness, government regulation, interest rates, business cycles, and monetary policy. Also includes topics in risk and intertemporal decision-making. 2 or 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 or 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: Finance - UIUC, MS:Finance -UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, or MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: May be offered as an 8-week course.
